# bitbottle

bitbottle is an independent MIT-licensed Go CLI for Bitbucket Cloud and Bitbucket Server/Data Center.

- Home: https://proggarapsody.github.io/bitbottle/
- Installation: https://proggarapsody.github.io/bitbottle/install/
- Pull request workflows: https://proggarapsody.github.io/bitbottle/pull-requests/
- AI and MCP: https://proggarapsody.github.io/bitbottle/ai-mcp/
- Source: https://github.com/proggarapsody/bitbottle
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@proggarapsody/bitbottle
- Go package: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/proggarapsody/bitbottle

Some commands are available on only one backend. Consult the command support matrix in the repository README.
